# تَنَاصَرْتَ (tanāṣarta) /ta.naː.sˤar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَاصَرَ (tanāṣara)
# تَنَاصَرْتِ (tanāṣarti) /ta.naː.sˤar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَاصَرَ (tanāṣara)
# تَنَاصَرَتْ (tanāṣarat) /ta.naː.sˤa.rat/: third-person
